body:
Junior 1 bedroom (Can be a small 2 bedroom) - Mission. Quiet, lots of sunlight! Laundry

Junior 1-Bedroom, 1 bath * Brand-new unit * New kitchen with all new appliances, including microwave * Long hallway * Hardwood floors * Good natural sunlight and apartment lighting * Good closet space * Secured building * On-site laundry * Storage closet * Close to all public transportation * Bathroom with shower and tub

An apt is available

ABOUT THE APARTMENT:
This is a very nice, brand-new junior 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom that can also be a small 2-bedroom. Located in the exciting Mission District and one block from Van Ness. Nice new kitchen with all-new appliances, including a microwave. It has polished hardwood floors throughout. There is a long hallway for art and paintings. Great sunlight and closet space. Also, a storage closet. Coin-operated laundry in the building.

LOCATION: 1750 Mission Street, Apt. 10, San Francisco, CA. 94103 (Cross Street Duboce)

PLEASE READ CAREFULLY AND FOLLOW INSTRUCTIONS WHEN CONTACTING:
Contact: Call or text Sason anytime

Live in the hip and vibrant Mission District! The apartment is very conveniently located, just 1 block from Van Ness, 13th, and Duboce, and a few blocks from the exciting Valencia Street. Close to many restaurants, bars, cafes, and shopping! The world-famous Rainbow Vegetarian Market is only a few blocks away. Whole Foods and Safeway are also nearby. There is a Target 2 blocks away and a Costco. Close to all transportation, including Muni lines 49 and 14, only half a block away, and very close to BART!

THE UNIT FEATURES:
Nice brand new junior 1 bedroom (can act as a small 2 bedroom)
Very quiet unit
1 new bathroom with tub and shower
Beautiful, new hardwood floors
Beautiful new kitchen with all new appliances, including a microwave
Long hallway
Lots of closet space
Nice windows with natural sunlight
Coin-operated laundry a few feet from the apartment (in the building)
Street parking
1 block to exciting Valencia Street
Close to all public transportation
A Cat is okay, NO DOGS.

Rent: $3195
Available: July 1st
